verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs say users can connect MCP servers as plugins for Warp's local agents. The same capability is documented for the Oz CLI's cloud agents, including examples like GitHub and Linear, and agent profiles that govern MCP server usage. Missing for 10: detailed setup/configuration docs (transports, config format) in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration that MCP tools work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP servers extend Warp’s local agents in a modular, flexible way by exposing custom tools or data sources through a standardized interface — essentially acting as plugins for Warp.
Connect Warp AI to any tool via the Model Context Protocol.
Connect agents to MCP servers like GitHub and Linear
Create profiles in the Warp app to configure file access, command execution, MCP server usage, model selection, and directory permissions
